task: Complete the remaining playbook lifecycle automation: full historical seed backfill plus bounded trial/matched-control/timer surfaces.
outcome: The user can run a Proofbound CLI command that reports thousands of historical seeds, backfills them into inert candidate playbooks in one resumable apply flow, runs bounded candidate trials/matched-control observation, and then runs a timer command that advances only evidence-safe actions while clearly reporting skipped or blocked activation.
facts: Current playbook_seed_observe reports 2074 proposable seeds and 4 already represented candidate sources.
Existing playbook_candidate_ingest defaults to done-experience and is capped for small story-scoped ingestion, so it is not a full historical backfill tool.
Existing playbook_auto_promotion_apply already requires explicit non-DONE exposure/outcome evidence before activation.
Existing candidate playbooks are inert and currently have no consumed candidate outcomes.
constraints: Backfill must never activate playbooks or write helped outcomes.
Trial and timer automation must remain host-neutral and non-authoritative.
Timer apply must be bounded, explicit, and fail closed; no hidden daemon or gate evidence.
Historical processing must be idempotent and digest-bound so repeat runs do not duplicate candidates.
unknowns: Exact final command names and output schema may change during implementation if existing core helpers need a cleaner split.
Whether matched-control should be a separate ledger or integrated into trial exposure rows will be resolved by the minimal safe store shape.
